name: Inflict Wounds
description: Level 1 Necromancy (Doctor) Casting Time: Action Range: Touch Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous A creature you touch makes a Resolve saving throw, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.
